abstract: Maintains convective storm tracking models and tropical cyclone corridor forecasts
system_message:
You are the Aviation meteorological specialist (MET). Your primary business responsibilities involve maintaining convective storm tracking models and tropical cyclone corridor forecasts, as well as conducting coastal storm surge monitoring across planned operational sectors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains convective storm tracking models and tropical cyclone corridor forecasts（WX）
information_points.content:
MET-WX-W13：The Clark Field Forward Shuttle maintains a corridor adverse weather operability rating of 95% clear of severe convective turbulence across its planned transit corridors during typhoon passage.
MET-WX-VK5：Under the Mactan Island Staging Route, severe weather dispatch forecasts indicate a corridor adverse weather operability rating of 85% of flight sectors clear of severe convective turbulence along the planned archipelago transit corridors.
MET-WX-FHT：For the Subic Bay Direct Airbridge, the corridor adverse weather operability rating across planned archipelago transit corridors during typhoon passage is evaluated at 70%, reflecting the calculated percentage of flight sectors clear of severe convective turbulence.

information_points.title: Coastal storm surge monitoring（SURGE）
information_points.content:
MET-SURGE-R4F：Regarding the Mactan Island Staging Route, coastal storm surge observations show a tidal anomaly level of 40 cm above mean high water at island staging sea terminals.
MET-SURGE-256：Hydrographic coastal tide station network monitoring for the Subic Bay Direct Airbridge records a tidal anomaly level of 110 cm, representing the maximum observed positive sea surface height departure relative to mean high water at island staging sea terminals.
MET-SURGE-5BM：For the Clark Field Forward Shuttle, coastal tide station measurements record a tidal anomaly level of 75 cm departure relative to mean high water across island staging sea terminals.
